name: desktop-opus-addon
description: N-API addon: libopus (deep PLC + OSCE) for qaudion-desktop. Built here (public repo) so the addon is compiled on free GitHub-hosted runners instead of the private qaudion-desktop repo's own Actions minutes. Not published to npm; consumed by qaudion-desktop as a downloaded, sha256-verified GitHub Release asset (see ../README.md).

scripts.build:electron: node -e "const cp=require('child_process');const v=require('./package.json').devDependencies.electron.replace(/^[^0-9]*/,'');const run=c=>cp.execSync(c,{stdio:'inherit'});run('npx node-gyp configure --target='+v+' --dist-url=https://electronjs.org/headers');run('npx node-gyp build')"
